# 15Five | Target Customers

| Customer group | Relevant need |
| --- | --- |
| Primary customer profile | Medium-sized and corporate clients wishing to hold managers accountable for continuous performance management. |
| Decision makers and governance | Typical decision makers include business leaders, sales/HR leaders, operations leaders, and IT/security teams.
